item.tib: 'chi med yab sras rnam gsum thugs bsgrubs las bzlog gzhung byed ma sgrol nag po
item.coloph: ces par bzlog (zlog) gzhung byad ma stong sgrol 'di yang shel brag tu sa phag zla ba'i yar tshes 10 la rig 'dzin chen pos tshogs gral nas bdag la rgyud lung gnang bzhin bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i gnyer gtad thub par byas nas slar ma d+hal ri khrod du shing sbrul zla 10tshes 9la lo tsa'i baN+DA' yig shar bzhin g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag gis tshes 10 kyi nyi shar bod yig tu gtan la phab pa'o
